=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- Requirement: "Each role resolves to claude by default with the right model (Sonnet 5.5 for utility roles). `AI_ENGINE_<ROLE>=codex` restores the old command line." (Linked issue #6701 acceptance criteria, applies to all seven roles.)
  Expected change site: The `review_autofix.yml` environment block / engine-resolution path for the `SUMMARISER` and `BEHAVIOURAL_SMOKE` roles, or the corresponding scripts (`scripts/summarize_reviewer_consensus.sh`, `scripts/review_synthesise_smoke.sh`).
  Evidence of absence: The implement.yml change forwards `AI_ENGINE_SUMMARISER: ${{ vars.AI_ENGINE_SUMMARISER || '' }}` into the engine resolver env (`implement.yml:2217`). The analogous review workflow (review_autofix.yml) is explicitly forbidden by the issue ("it is about 472 KB"), and no equivalent export was added. `scripts/summarize_reviewer_consensus.sh:330-335` and `scripts/review_synthesise_smoke.sh:805-810` resolve the role with `AI_ENGINE_MODEL_HINT` / `AI_ENGINE_EFFORT_HINT` only — they read `AI_ENGINE_SUMMARISER` / `AI_ENGINE_BEHAVIOURAL_SMOKE` implicitly through `ai_engine_for_role` via the sourced engine script, but those env vars are never exported by review_autofix.yml. The PR's own changelog (`changelog.d/6701-claude-log-analysis-utility-roles.md:13`) acknowledges this: "The review roles read the label and `AI_ENGINE` only, because `review_autofix.yml` does not forward the per-role variable." Setting `vars.AI_ENGINE_SUMMARISER=codex` therefore has no effect on the review summariser call (or vice-versa for BEHAVIOURAL_SMOKE) — only the global `AI_ENGINE=codex` repo var or the `ai:codex` label rolls them back, which also disables the other Claude review write roles. The acceptance criterion is partially unmet for these two review-side roles.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- Requirement: "AI_ENGINE_<ROLE>=codex restores the old command line" (goal G4 from linked issue #6701)
  Expected change site: `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` environment exports for `AI_ENGINE_SUMMARISER` and `AI_ENGINE_BEHAVIOURAL_SMOKE`
  Evidence of absence: The PR adds `AI_ENGINE_SUMMARISER` to `implement.yml` (line 2217) and `AI_ENGINE_RETRO`, `AI_ENGINE_LOG_SUMMARY`, `AI_ENGINE_LOG_ANALYSIS`, `AI_ENGINE_LOG_AUDIT` to `workflow-log-analysis.yml`, but does not forward `AI_ENGINE_SUMMARISER` or `AI_ENGINE_BEHAVIOURAL_SMOKE` to the review scripts. The scripts `scripts/summarize_reviewer_consensus.sh` (line 332) and `scripts/review_synthesise_smoke.sh` (line 806) call `ai_engine_for_role` which reads these variables from the environment, but `review_autofix.yml` does not export them. An operator setting `AI_ENGINE_SUMMARISER=codex` as a repo variable cannot roll back these review roles to codex. The linked issue explicitly forbids editing `review_autofix.yml` due to size, but states "If an env var must reach the review scripts, give it a default inside the script" - the scripts have defaults for the engine resolution logic, but the workflow must still forward the repo variable to the environment. The existing resolver step in `review_autofix.yml` (around line 2200-2230) forwards `AI_ENGINE` and the four review-write-role variables (`AI_ENGINE_REVIEW_EDITOR`, `AI_ENGINE_REVIEW_CONSOLIDATOR`, `AI_ENGINE_CONFLICT_RESOLVER`, `AI_ENGINE_RB_JUDGE`), but not the two utility roles added by this PR.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
